title: Roland Coker
clean_html:
Roland Coker

Preserved Primary Document • coker-r2.htm

He married Hazella Sammons, the daughter of William Sammons and Ella Durham, on 26 October, 1940. Hazella was born in Kent Co., DE on 19 July, 1915. They had the following children: Elaine Coker (b. 22 Aug. 1943-1994) married Clarence Muntz children: Wythena Marie Muntz Valerie Susann Muntz Arlena "Pinky" Coker (b. 31 July, 1948- ) Roland James Coker (b.22 Nov. 1950- ) married Michelle Bosligo Roland died on 25 April, 1995. Hazella died on 10 January, 1996. Both are buried at Immanuel Union (Manship) Church in Cheswold.
